visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in two buns wears a black oversized jacket and white skirt while holding a large drink cup. A man in a white t-shirt stands next to her in a brightly lit shopping mall corridor. (2) The woman removes her jacket to reveal a white t-shirt underneath. The man presents a modified black jacket with prosthetic human arms attached. (3) The woman wears the modified jacket; the prosthetic arms are positioned to hold the drink and her phone, while her real arms are hidden. (4) A series of quick cuts shows the woman walking through a shopping mall with the extra arms, while bystanders stare or look confused. (5) The scene shifts to the entrance of a '7-ELEVEN LOFT Select' store where the couple speaks directly to the camera. (6) The woman walks through the store aisles filled with colorful character merchandise and plush toys. (7) She holds up various products, including Hello Kitty plushes, Chiikawa stickers, and Shin-chan merchandise. (8) The camera focuses on a Shonen Jump Shop photo printing machine where a user selects manga character cards. (9) A montage of different store sections follows, featuring stationery, blind boxes like Sonny Angel and Smiski, and localized limited-edition items. (10) The couple, now joined by a small girl eating an ice cream cone, stands at the checkout counter and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic BGM starts immediately with a high-energy male vocal introduction. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the camera cuts to the four-armed jacket reveal. (3) Comedic, bouncy music plays while the female speaker reacts with an exaggerated high-pitched tone. (4) Frequent 'pop' and 'cartoon' SFX occur during the mall montage as people's reactions are shown. (5) The audio transitions to a bright, upbeat promotional style as the male narrator introduces the 7-Eleven store with a very fast speech rate. (6) Rustling sounds of product packaging are heard clearly during the merchandise showcase. (7) A 'ding' UI sound effect plays as the photo card is printed. (8) The track concludes with the couple and a child speaking in a friendly, enthusiastic collective tone over a swelling musical finale.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the grand opening of the 7-Eleven LOFT Select store in Kaohsiung. It uses a humorous 'four-armed jacket' skit to capture viewer attention before transitioning into a comprehensive showcase of the store's exclusive character merchandise and membership rewards.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of store name, opening date, specific products, and membership point bonuses.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines social media comedy trends (the prosthetic arm prank) with professional retail promotion to maximize engagement for a brand opening.
